note: This file is the ONLY authorization the live lane trusts. Fill 'inScope' ONLY with assets you have personally verified on the official program policy page, and set 'verifiedByUser': true only after that check. A discovery feed, this repo, and this file are NOT permission — the official program policy always controls authorization. Empty inScope or verifiedByUser=false means the scope guard denies everything (fail-closed).

abode-intigriti.policyUrl: PASTE the exact Intigriti program URL here
notes: 1. Open the official Intigriti program policy for Abode.
2. Copy each in-scope domain/host/wildcard into 'inScope' EXACTLY as written (e.g. 'app.example.com', '*.example.com').
3. Copy every out-of-scope entry into 'outOfScope' (out-of-scope wins over in-scope in the guard).
4. Confirm the program is open, paid, offers safe harbor, and is available to your country.
5. Only then set verifiedByUser=true. Until then the guard denies all live actions.
6. The guard ALWAYS blocks loopback/RFC1918/link-local/metadata IPs regardless of this file.
